description:
## Problem
The approved mirror-validator design adds benchbox/core/results/standard_scales.json to the mirrored files. The submission guard in .github/workflows/validate-submission.yml must stay byte-identical between develop and published-results, and the published-results copy changes only through a hand-opened PR there, so #4463 could not add the new file to the guard list. A community submission PR could therefore edit standard_scales.json without the guard rejecting it.

## Change
A coordinated pair of pull requests: add the file to the guard list on published-results and on develop, landing so the sync check stays green.

## Verification rubric
Pass: both copies list the file; the validator sync check passes; a submission PR touching the file is rejected (test or recorded run).
